description: ChronoGolf login session had expired before the scheduled midnight booking run. The skill verified login status but did not have recovery mechanism to re-authenticate using 1Password.
root_cause: Step 2 of golf-booking skill had no login recovery logic. When session expired, skill aborted instead of retrieving Susie O'Hara credentials from 1Password and re-authenticating.
impact: Booking failed to execute. No tee time was booked for Father's Day (June 21). Manual intervention required.
correction_made:
Updated golf-booking/SKILL.md Step 2 to include automatic login recovery:
1. Detect expired session (check for '41 - Frisco Lakes Total Member' in page text)
2. If not logged in, use 1Password skill to fetch susie@oharafamily.com credentials
3. Execute login flow via Chrome
4. Re-verify login status
5. Only abort if login fails after retry

Added Rule #1 to MANDATORY EXECUTION RULES to emphasize automatic recovery.
lessons: Scheduled midnight tasks must include automatic session recovery for authenticated services
Do not assume Chrome session state persists between previous run and scheduled execution
Build login recovery into the workflow — treat it as a normal step, not an error condition
Use password managers (1Password) as a service dependency for critical automations
follow_up: Next scheduled golf booking run (Tuesday June 17 11pm) will include login recovery. Manually test recovery logic if possible before then.
